newsitem.title: UK: Avesco buys 51 pct of AVTS for 5.9 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Avesco buys 51 pct of AVTS for 5.9 mln stg.

text.p: Avesco Plc said on Wednesday it had bought 51 percent of U.S. firm AVTS Inc for a maximum 5.9 million stg with an option to buy the remaining 49 percent.
AVTS is a leading U.S. supplier of specialist video based technical services to the corporate communication, broadcast and entertainment markets.
"The acquisition of this controlling interest in AVTS is an important step in Avesco's expansion into the North American market," chief executive David Nicholson said in a statement.
Avesco provides specialist television related services in Europe, Australasia and North America.
